Name: Caiaphas
Summary: Caiaphas was high priest during Jesus' ministry and trial. He advised that one man should die for the people, presided over the night hearing that condemned Jesus, and later opposed the apostles.
KeyStory: Caiaphas tore his clothes at Jesus' claim and declared Him guilty of blasphemy before the council.
LifeLesson: Caiaphas was right that one man would die for the people, and wrong about everything it meant. God can speak truth through unwilling lips.
